title: Step 3 - Analyzing Naive Bayes Algorithm Results: Accuracy and Predictions

cues.en: -: Alright, so that's for the training set.
cues.zh: 好，訓練集就到這裡。

cues.en: And now let's come in quickly on the test set.
cues.zh: 現在快速說明測試集。

cues.en: Alright, this is already executed.
cues.zh: 好，已經執行完。

cues.en: Perfect.
cues.zh: 很好。

cues.en: So here are the results of Naive Bayes on the test set.
cues.zh: 這是樸素貝氏在測試集上的結果。

cues.en: And, actually, we realized that here we were pretty unlucky.
cues.zh: 實際上會發現，我們這裡運氣不太好。

cues.en: You know, Naive Bayes was pretty unlucky because the three predictions that it missed, You know- This red customer that falls incorrectly in the green region
cues.zh: 樸素貝氏有點倒楣，因為漏掉的這三筆預測，也就是這位錯落在綠色區域的紅色顧客，

cues.en: and these two green customers that fall incorrectly in the red region.
cues.zh: 以及這兩位錯落在紅色區域的綠色顧客。

cues.en: Well, Naive Bayes was pretty unlucky on this one because you know, they're almost on the prediction boundary and it is what it missed by very closely to beat the record.
cues.zh: 這幾筆真有點可惜，因為幾乎就在預測邊界上，只差一點點，就能打破紀錄。

cues.en: And same for this one actually, you know?
cues.zh: 這個其實也一樣，對吧？

cues.en: This one was very shortly missed, right?
cues.zh: 這個也只差一點點。

cues.en: Because it is an incorrect prediction of a customer who in reality didn't buy the SUV because it's red but was predicted to buy the SUV because it falls in the green region.
cues.zh: 因為這是錯誤預測：顧客實際沒有購買 SUV，所以是紅點，卻被預測會購買，因為落在綠色區域。

cues.en: So, pretty unlucky, which explains the accuracy of 90%.
cues.zh: 所以有點倒楣，這解釋了 90% 的準確率。

cues.en: I think that if we tune a bit Naive Bayes, we could beat the record, but once again that will be in part 10.
cues.zh: 我想稍微調整樸素貝氏，就可能打破紀錄，但這一樣留到第十部分。

cues.en: And now the next step will be to buy the last two classification models, which belong to a branch of machine learning called Ensemble Models.
cues.zh: 下一步要建立最後兩個分類模型，它們屬於機器學習的一個分支，稱為集成模型。

cues.en: I'm talking of course about decision tree classification and random forest classification.
cues.zh: 當然就是決策樹分類與隨機森林分類。

cues.en: And actually with these two, and especially Random Forest, we might have a chance to beat that record accuracy.
cues.zh: 這兩個，尤其是隨機森林，可能有機會打破準確率紀錄。

cues.en: You know, we might beat 93%.
cues.zh: 可能超越 93%。

cues.en: So, that's what's on the menu for this end of part 3.
cues.zh: 這就是第三部分結尾的內容。

cues.en: So, I can't wait to see you in the next part.
cues.zh: 迫不及待在下一部分見到你。

cues.en: Build first the decision tree classification model and then finally the random forest classification.
cues.zh: 先建立決策樹分類模型，最後再建立隨機森林分類模型。

cues.en: And until then, enjoy machine learning!
cues.zh: 在此之前，享受機器學習吧！
